text: Jorge's new puppy arrives Saturday morning, a little beagle called Pepper. He's taken the whole week off to settle her in and has bought basically every toy in Pets at Home. His girlfriend Nina is less sure, she grew up with cats and is worried about the carpets. They've booked puppy classes starting sometime in November, Sunday mornings. Remind me to drop round the week after she arrives with a chew toy.
remind me to text Obi the day before his driving test, its thurs at 2pm i think. hes really nervous after failing the first one
Dorota's cat Bisou has been off her food since the weekend. Vet on Monday at 10. She sounded pretty shaken on the phone.
pick up dry cleaning, return the drill to B&Q, get stamps. Before 5 tomorrow ideally
Nina said Hannah and her husband are finally doing their trip to Lisbon sometime over the summer. Hannah's never been abroad with the kids before.
Bethany - allergic to tree nuts, mild lactose thing too. Loves bouldering, goes Tuesdays and Thursdays.

So Teresa's mum is having her hip done early March, they don't have a date yet. Teresa's going to stay with her for a fortnight after. I should ring Teresa the week after the op to see how they're both getting on.
Bao's dog Kimchi turns 5 on the 18th. Apparently there's a party. With a cake. For the dog.
Erin got the job!! starts end of the month at the council, planning dept
need to book the car in for MOT sometime next week, mornings only
Saanvi mentioned her brother Liam is moving to Leeds in the new year for work. She's a bit gutted, they're really close.
Santiago and Alessia's housewarming is Friday at 7. Don't forget to grab a plant or something on the way that afternoon.

Call with Nasser. His dad's back in hospital, chest infection again, third time this year. He's been driving up to Leicester every other day after work and not sleeping much. His brother's useless apparently, lives in Dubai and just sends messages. Nasser said the doctors might know more by Thursday afternoon. Check in with him tomorrow evening, and maybe offer to cover his Saturday shift.
nora mentioned she's been wanting one of those fancy pasta machines for ages. xmas idea??
Matilda's leaving do got cancelled, apparently half the team's off with flu. Rescheduling to sometime in November maybe.
Leon - starting a pottery course in the spring, Wednesday nights. Said he's terrible at it already from the taster.
Ibrahim's wife Alina is expecting! Due early April. Their second. He was grinning the whole time.
remind me to message Beatriz that evening to see how the audition went. it's the 12th at half 9 in the morning
I'm doing the drive to Anil's on Sunday, leaving around 8. Bringing the folding chairs.
Kofi Osei - Kof to everyone at work - just got promoted to team lead. Drinks at the Crown next Thursday from 6.
Esme says the rescue finally approved them for a kitten. Collecting her the weekend after next. Her daughter's already picked a name, Biscuit.
liam's nan passed away on sunday. funeral sometime next week, he'll let me know. send flowers to his mum's place before then
Andre is training for the Manchester half in April, his first one. Knee's been playing up though.
Yosef said his sister Nora got into Edinburgh for medicine. Family's over the moon.
Spoke to Aoife about the reunion, it's Saturday the 22nd at 1pm at the Fox. She's organising so she's a bit stressed. I'm bringing the photo albums.
Julia and her partner Andre just got engaged in Florence last weekend. Wedding probably summer after next. Must send a card this week.
elijah has his PhD viva friday at 3pm. remind me thursday night to wish him luck, he's been a wreck all month
Jamal - lives in Walthamstow now, just off the high street. Works nights at the hospital lab, so text don't call before 2.
Alina's guinea pigs had to be rehomed, her landlord found out. She's really upset about it, especially Pip.

ok so Ilse is flying back to Hamburg on the 3rd for her dad's 70th, early flight, like 6am. Her whole family's going, cousins from Austria too, first time they've all been together since her grandma's funeral. She's a bit nervous about seeing her aunt after some falling out. Back the following Tuesday evening. Ask her how it went when she's back.
note to self: renew passport before end of the month. Photo booth at Tesco
Jorge again - Pepper's chewed through two chargers and a shoe already. He's knackered but loves her.
Dentist moved to Wednesday at 11:15. Cancel the gym that morning.
Obi passed!! Second time lucky. Get him a card and maybe a keyring for the new car, and congratulate him properly on Saturday.

Bumped into Nina and Dorota at the market. Dorota said Bisou's on tablets now and doing loads better, eating again. Nina's off to Kraków with her boyfriend in early December for the Christmas markets. Neither of them has heard from Teresa in a while so I said I'd check.
Hannah's little one Matilda starts nursery in January, mornings only to begin with. Hannah's dreading the first drop off.
Remind me to call Mrs Baker the week after her cataract surgery. It's on the 9th, afternoon I think. Her neighbour Bao is driving her.

So I was chatting to Bethany after class and she's thinking about quitting her job at the agency. Hates the new manager, has done since about June. She's got an interview at a design studio in Shoreditch on Tuesday at 4pm and she's honestly terrified about it. I should text her Tuesday lunchtime to say good luck, and then that evening to ask how it went.
Teresa's fine, just been snowed under. Her mum's op got pushed to mid March.
buy dog food, bin bags, lightbulbs for the hallway
Erin's birthday is the 28th. She mentioned wanting a new yoga mat, hers is falling apart. Maybe go halves with Saanvi.
Uncle Santiago is retiring at Christmas after 30 years at the railway. Big do planned for the 20th in the evening.
Nasser's dad is home, thank god. Still weak though. Nasser's taking a few days off from Thursday.
Bao is vegetarian, not vegan, eats eggs. Hates coriander with a passion. Good to know for the dinner.
Nora's dog Rolo had his op this morning, a lump removed from his leg. Stitches out in ten days. Remind me to ask her that weekend how he's healing.

Matilda says she's been really low since the move to Glasgow, doesn't know anyone up there yet. Her flatmate's away a lot with work and the new job is fine but nobody really talks to each other. She's thinking about joining a running club, there's one that meets Wednesday evenings by the river. Need to ring her sometime this week, maybe Sunday afternoon when she's free, and send her that book she wanted.

Leon's band has a gig at the Jazz Cafe on the 14th, doors 8pm, their biggest one so far. He's been rehearsing every night and says the new drummer is finally getting it. I'm going with Ibrahim, meeting at Camden Town station around half 7. Leon's girlfriend Aoife is doing the merch table.
vet for the cat: jabs due early next month. Ring them Monday to book
Beatriz Barros has her citizenship test on the 5th at 10. She's been revising every night after work, says she's fine but she's clearly anxious. Don't forget to text her the night before.

Had Anil and his wife round for dinner last night. Their son Santiago just got his A level results, straight A's, and he's off to Bristol in September for engineering. Anil's already worrying about the cost of halls and keeps sending me spreadsheets. His wife is coeliac, totally forgot, luckily the risotto was fine. They want us to come to theirs sometime early in the new year.

Kofi's mum is visiting from Accra for three weeks over the summer, first time she's been to the UK. He's planning a whole itinerary: Edinburgh, the Lake District, a show in the West End. His sister Esme is flying over from Toronto for the middle week so the whole family can be together. He asked if I know any good places in York, should send him that list from last year.
Esme's kitten Biscuit is home and already rules the house. She sent about forty photos.
Liam seemed alright today. Said the funeral was lovely. He's going back to work Monday.
Andre had to drop out of the half marathon. Knee injury, physio says six weeks off running. He's gutted. Should send him something to cheer him up next week.
car insurance renews on the 30th, compare quotes over the weekend
Yosef's 40th - Saturday the 16th at 8pm, his wife Ilse is organising a surprise at their place. Don't tell him. Chipping in for the watch, transfer Ilse £20 by Friday.
aoife said the reunion went brilliantly in the end, 30 odd people turned up. she was so relieved
Julia's starting a new role at the museum next month, curator for the textiles collection. Been after it for years.
Elijah passed his viva with minor corrections!! Celebrating sometime next week, he'll send a date.

Rang Jamal. His cat Mango went missing Tuesday night and still hasn't come back. She's an indoor cat mostly so he's beside himself, been out with a torch every night calling her. The microchip company have been notified and the vet's got her details. He's putting posters up tomorrow morning before his shift. Remind me to share his post on the local group tonight, and check in with him Friday.
